attempts.sql: WITH cg AS (SELECT symbol_id, file_id FROM code.symbols WHERE name = 'create_graph' AND file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py'), args AS (SELECT c.call_id, c.callee_name, c.line FROM code.calls c JOIN cg ON c.caller_symbol_id = cg.symbol_id WHERE c.call_kind = 'call' AND c.callee_name IS NOT NULL), plain AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.callee_name FROM args a WHERE a.callee_name ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$' AND a.callee_name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM code.symbols WHERE file_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py') AND a.callee_name NOT IN ('if','else','for','while','return','lambda','True','False','None')) SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s JOIN plain p ON s.name = p.callee_name WHERE s.kind IN ('function','method') ORDER BY s.symbol_id

request:
When the text-to-SQL LangGraph is assembled by create_graph in auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py, which functions or methods of this repository does create_graph hand over by reference, i.e. pass the function object itself as an argument to another call (as with graph.add_conditional_edges(node, router_fn, ...)) rather than calling it? Count only plain names passed directly as call arguments; functions that create_graph calls itself, values that are the result of a call (such as _make_soft_check_router(...)), lambdas, and local variables holding nodes do not count. Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds create_graph in the text_to_sql graph module, collects the callee names it passes as plain identifiers in call arguments, excludes names that are local definitions in the same file (helpers it calls or constructs) and non-function keywords, then resolves the remaining names to repository function/method symbol IDs.
